|More, then! Bring me more relics of the past! Records, seals, idols! Let's gather up the history of the world and hoard it all here, nice and safe!
|[[Relic Seeker Scrounge]]}}

<b>Bone Scrolls</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Tradables|tradable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are journals written by pilgrims on their way to the [[Citadel]], and can be deciphered by [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]].  

== Use ==
Can be sold to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]] for {{R|90}}.

After sale, they can be read by visiting Relic Seeker Scrounge, or in the [[Bellhome]] after purchasing the [[Desk]].
